2607.11213.title: When the Target Domain Changes: AI-Mediated Construct Drift in High-Stakes English Language AssessmenW
2607.11213.paper_summary: High-stakes English proficiency tests treat standardized, unaided performance as evidence for score interpretations about academic English proficiency. This interpretation remains meaningful, but as target language use domains increasingly involve generative AI, the extrapolation from unaided test performance to academic communicative readiness becomes less self-evident. This conceptual validity argument reframes AI as a score-interpretation problem in high-stakes language testing, not only an operational issue of scoring, feedback, security, or misconduct. Synthesizing current literature in three uneven layers, the paper shows that most work treats AI as assessment infrastructure, while far less theorizes its implications for construct validity and extrapolation warrants. It defines AI-mediated construct drift as the misalignment that arises when communicative abilities required in the target domain change through AI mediation while test constructs remain anchored to an unaided-performance model. It proposes bounded AI mediation as a validity-oriented design principle: a standardized condition in which all test takers access the same institutionally controlled AI assistant, with predefined assistance boundaries, logged interactions, and tasks that distinguish comprehension support from answer generation. The paper argues that score interpretations should be narrowed and supplemented when used to support claims about AI-mediated academic communication.
2607.11213.paper_summary_zh: 高風險的英語能力測試將標準化、未經協助的表現視為學術英語能力評分解釋的證據。這種解釋仍然具有意義，但隨著目標語言使用領域越來越多地涉及生成式人工智慧，從未經協助的測試表現推斷學術交流準備的過程變得不再那麼顯而易見。這一概念有效性論證將人工智慧重新框架為高風險語言測試中的評分解釋問題，而不僅僅是評分、反饋、安全或不當行為的操作性問題。通過三個不均勻的層次綜合當前文獻，本文顯示大多數研究將人工智慧視為評估基礎設施，而對其對構念有效性和推斷授權的影響則理論探討得較少。它將人工智慧介導的構念漂移定義為當目標領域所需的交流能力通過人工智慧介導而改變，而測試構念仍然固定於未經協助的表現模型時所產生的不一致。它提出以有限的人工智慧介導作為一種以有效性為導向的設計原則：一種標準化條件，在此條件下，所有考生都可以訪問相同的機構控制的人工智慧助手，並具有預定的協助邊界、記錄的互動和區分理解支持與答案生成的任務。本文主張，當用於支持關於人工智慧介導的學術交流的主張時，應縮小並補充評分解釋。
2607.11213.author: Yi Gui et.al.
